environment.description: Spring Boot application deployed as a container on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with public internet-facing listener on port 443. No authentication middleware configured. ALB forwards all requests to the target group. Spring Boot default error handling exposes stack traces in responses (server.error.include-stacktrace=always). Any internet client can send malformed JSON payloads to trigger NullPointerException, causing 500 errors with full stack trace disclosure and potential service degradation through repeated crash-inducing requests.
